title: CCC Structural Folding Runtime: Metric Clustering, Structural Merge, and Runtime Localization
description: CCC Structural Folding Runtime (CSFR) is a general structural runtime framework for transforming metric-space object collections into folded CCC structures that support runtime dispatch, structural localization, and localized intelligence. CSFR distinguishes object-to-object distance (D_PP), object-to-CCC distance (D_PC), and CCC-to-CCC distance (D_CC); introduces policy-compressed Cluster CCCs and aligned Sequence Claw-Dragon Merge; and extends runtime search through CCC DNA, reverse structural indexing, Two-Way CCC, and Two-Phase Structural Search. The canonical runtime progression is: Metric -> Cluster -> Merge -> CCC -> DNA -> Retrieve -> Verify -> Localization. The repository also includes Stock-Market Structural Folding as the first canonical application case, demonstrating how historical metric-space patterns can be folded into runtime-localizable structural regimes while keeping structural localization distinct from downstream prediction.
